payout_quote: Volunteers receive a stipend starting at $150 for early voting days and $235 for Election Day. All vote centers are open 3 days before Election Day, and several are open 10 days before Election Day. This includes weekends. On early voting days vote center hours are 8 a.m.-5 p.m. Election Day hours are 7 a.m.-8 p.m. Election Day can be long (14+ hours).
steps: Be at least 18 years old, a U.S. citizen, and a registered voter in California or a noncitizen with permanent resident status otherwise eligible to vote.
Sign up as a volunteer via the 2026 Election Volunteer Application at stanvote.gov.
Attend required training (duration and pay unstated; excluded from the payout and time below).
Work Election Day: vote center hours 7am-8pm, documented as a 14+ hour commitment.
catches: Stipend is 'starting at $235' for Election Day - the actual amount can be higher; $235 is the documented figure.
Election Day is documented as 14+ hours with no fixed end; 840 minutes is the documented figure, not a maximum.
Required training has unstated duration and pay, so it is excluded from the payout and time below.
Election-period work only; must be able to lift 20-30 lbs and sit/stand for long periods.
biggest_catch: $235 (starting at) for an Election Day of 14+ hours - both are documented figures with no fixed maximum; required training is excluded (duration/pay unstated).
eligibility: 18+; US citizen; CA registered voter or eligible permanent-resident noncitizen; attend training; lift 20-30 lbs; reliable transportation.
timing: Early voting days + Election Day per the county election calendar.
